prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1314; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a collision that occurred while the patient's vehicle was turning left and was struck from the side. The reported mechanism is consistent with the shoulder injury described, and the presenting complaints align with this type of impact. Over the course of 22 visits, care included physical examination, a structured rehabilitation program, and monitored range-of-motion exercises. Treatment progressed along a typical clinical pathway, with visit frequency decreasing as pain and mobility improved and the patient was discharged to a home exercise routine. Several examination findings, including limited abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff, support the reported injury, while other orthopedic and neurological tests returned normal results. No prior injury to the same shoulder region is documented in the available history. Billing records reflect single entries for each service without repeated or duplicate charges. Ongoing monitoring is recommended should symptoms recur.
